errors.invoice_inventory_direction_unknown: The warehouse cannot be moved: it is unclear whether the invoice is a sale or a purchase. Set the principal company or classify the invoice.
errors.invoice_inventory_status_not_allowed: Only an issued invoice moves the warehouse; a quotation does not.
errors.invoice_inventory_no_lines: The invoice has no authorized lines to move.
errors.inventory_adjustment_not_authorized: Adjusting stock requires warehouse manager permission. An adjustment changes inventory with no document behind it, which is why it is separate from receiving and issuing.
errors.cancellation_motive_invalid: That cancellation motive is not in the SAT catalog.
errors.cancellation_substitution_required: Motive 01 requires the fiscal folio of the replacing document.
errors.cancellation_substitution_not_allowed: Only motive 01 carries a replacement folio.

errors.cancellation_requires_stamped_invoice: Only a stamped document can be cancelled.
errors.cancellation_already_requested: There is already a cancellation request for this invoice.

errors.payment_invoice_status_not_allowed: The invoice status does not accept payments.

errors.payment_amount_must_be_positive: The payment amount must be greater than zero.

errors.auth_too_many_attempts: Too many failed attempts. Wait a few minutes before trying again.
errors.inventory_asset_tag_already_used: Another asset already uses that tag. Two tools with the same tag make tracking useless.
errors.inventory_product_is_not_serialized: This product is tracked by quantity, not unit by unit. Switch it to serialized to track each piece.
errors.inventory_asset_is_retired: That asset is retired and does not come back. If it reappeared, register it as a new asset so its earlier history stays closed.
errors.inventory_asset_transition_not_allowed: That is not possible from the asset's current state.
errors.inventory_asset_not_in_stock: The asset is not in the warehouse, so it cannot be moved between locations.
errors.inventory_asset_due_date_in_the_past: That due date has already passed. A loan starts with a future date.
errors.pos_gateway_not_configured: The point-of-sale bridge is not configured on the server.
errors.pos_unreachable: The point of sale is not responding.
errors.pos_gateway_credentials_rejected: The point of sale rejected the bridge credentials.
errors.pos_gateway_unexpected_response: The point of sale returned something unexpected while authenticating.
errors.permission_denied: You do not have access to this. If the document belongs to another project, it cannot be used from yours.
errors.voucher_lines_required: The voucher needs at least one line: with none it does not say what went out.
errors.voucher_asset_required: That product is tracked piece by piece: say which one is going out. Handing back “a screwdriver” does not settle the loan of the one taken.
errors.voucher_asset_not_applicable: That product is counted by quantity, not by pieces: “one piece of cement” does not exist.
errors.voucher_asset_product_mismatch: That piece belongs to another product: the voucher would name something that never went out.
errors.voucher_line_already_closed: That line was already returned. Closing it again would lose the date it came back.
errors.voucher_line_not_a_loan: That line is a return, not a loan: there is nothing to give back.
errors.voucher_due_date_in_the_past: The return date is already past: the voucher would be born overdue.
errors.material_attribute_already_exists: That family already has a characteristic with that name. With two alive, half the materials fill one and half the other.
errors.material_attribute_options_required: A list needs its allowed values: without them it is a text field by another name.
errors.material_attribute_options_not_applicabl: That characteristic is not a list, so it carries no allowed values.
errors.material_attribute_option_already_exists: That value is already in the list.
errors.material_attribute_option_in_use: Some material picked that value. Remove it from those materials first.
errors.material_attribute_type_is_fixed: The data type cannot be changed: values already captured would keep the old type's shape. Declare another characteristic.
errors.material_attribute_in_use: There are materials using that characteristic. Remove it from those materials first.
errors.material_attribute_not_in_family: That characteristic belongs to another family: the value would end up where nobody looks for it.
errors.material_attribute_value_not_allowed: That value is not in the characteristic's list.
errors.lot_expiry_mismatch: That lot is already registered with a different expiry date. It is nearly always a typo in one of the two, and it silently changes the order things go out in.
errors.lot_insufficient_stock: There is not that much spread across lots. The balance and the lot breakdown do not match: something moved stock without going through the warehouse.
errors.lot_not_applicable: That product is not tracked by lots. It is nearly always the wrong product.
errors.lot_product_mismatch: That lot belongs to another product.
errors.lot_control_not_for_serialized: That product is tracked piece by piece, so it already has one row per unit: lots would be the same thing by two paths.
errors.lot_control_needs_its_own_endpoint: Lot control is not switched on from here: do it from the product, so the stock already on hand lands inside an opening lot.

material_type.title: Families and types
material_type.subtitle: The two levels of the classification: the family groups —screwdrivers, cement— and the type tells them apart within it —flat, phillips, bagged, bulk—.
material_type.none_yet: No types yet. The materials in this family cannot be told apart.
material_type.no_families: No families yet. A type hangs off a family, so start with the family: “Screwdrivers”, and inside it “Flat” and “Phillips”.
material_type.orphans_hint: Their family is not in the list. They still show up on the materials that use them.
material_type.family_has_types: That family has types inside it. Remove the types first, or they would point at a family that no longer exists.

voucher.title: Warehouse vouchers
voucher.subtitle: Who took what, from where, and whether it came back. A voucher closes itself when its last line returns.
voucher.closed_all: That was the last line: the voucher is closed.
voucher.closed_one: Line closed. The voucher is still open.
voucher.search_product: Search by code, description or asset tag
voucher.no_available: No piece available: they are lent, under repair or lost.
voucher.no_lines_yet: No lines. An empty voucher cannot be opened.
voucher.missing: The holder is missing, or the destination of a line that changes location.

attribute.title: Characteristics

attribute.type_number_help: Stored as a number, so “6 or more” really compares.
attribute.type_list_help: Only the values you declare. Keeps “matte”, “Matte” and “MATTE” apart from each other.

attribute.type_is_fixed: The data type cannot be changed later: values already captured would keep the old type's shape.
